name: Arcane Anchor
summary: A Riftseeker‑maintained stabilizer preventing the Ruined City of Dranik from collapsing into Discord.
description: The Arcane Anchor is a fragile planar stabilizer maintained by Riftseekers deep within the ruins of Dranik. Discord ruptures pulse around the anchor, temporal fractures distort reality, and Muramite forces attempt to seize or sabotage the stabilizer. The anchor’s arcane core emits powerful resonance, creating both danger and opportunity for those who approach.
